step1_analysis.description: A passive LC tank circuit extracted from a VCO, consisting of an inductor, capacitors, and a resistor. It determines the oscillation frequency of the VCO and provides the parallel resonance required for oscillation.

paper_reference.title: A 33.6-to-46.2GHz 32nm CMOS VCO with 177.5dBc/Hz Minimum Noise FOM Using Inductor Splitting for Tuning Extension

f_res.description: Resonant frequency of the LC tank

sky130_expected.calculation: f_res = 1 / (2 * pi * sqrt(L * C_total)). With L=100pH and C_total~100fF, f_res is around 40-50GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Targeting the paper's reported frequency range by parameterizing the passive components.

Q_factor.description: Quality factor of the LC tank

sky130_expected.calculation: Q = f_res / BW_3dB. Dominated by inductor and varactor losses.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Typical on-chip LC tanks in CMOS have Q factors in the range of 10 to 20 at mm-wave frequencies.
Determines the required negative resistance from the active cross-coupled pair to sustain oscillation.

step3_testbench.description: AC analysis to measure the resonant frequency, peak impedance, and 3dB bandwidth of the LC tank.
step3_testbench.spice:
* LC Tank Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param L_val=100p C_val=50f C_gnd=20f R_gnd=1k C_tune=20f

* DUT
L1 n2 n1 {L_val}
C1 n1 n2 {C_val}
C2 n0 n2 {C_gnd}
R1 n0 n2 {R_gnd}
C3 n1 label_net_0 {C_tune}

* Biasing and Ground
Vn0 n0 0 0
VLABEL_NET_0 label_net_0 0 0.9

* AC Current Source for Impedance Measurement
Iac n2 n1 DC 0 AC 1

.ac dec 100 1G 100G

.control
run
let Z = v(n2) - v(n1)
let Z_mag = mag(Z)

meas ac Z_max MAX Z_mag
meas ac f_res WHEN Z_mag=Z_max

let Z_3db = Z_max / 1.4142
meas ac f_low WHEN Z_mag=Z_3db RISE=1
meas ac f_high WHEN Z_mag=Z_3db FALL=1

print f_res Z_max f_low f_high
quit
.endc
.end
